record.question: Which of the following correctly describes the penalty under Rule 11 relating to reduction by one stage in the time-scale of pay?
options: It is a major penalty because it affects pay
It is a minor penalty only if it is imposed for less than one year
It is a minor penalty where the reduction is by one stage for a period not exceeding three years, without cumulative effect and without adversely affecting pension
It is not a penalty if the Government servant continues to hold the same post
